title: Peta Ekosistem Industri Game 2020
publisher: Direktorat Ekonomi Digital / Ministry of Communication and Informatics; research with LIPI and Asosiasi Game Indonesia
years: 2019 study focus; data collection 2020; published April 2021
methodology: Official ecosystem mapping from a quantitative non-probability survey. Incorporated companies: census approach; unincorporated actors: community-database snowball sampling, supported by three outreach events and one official release. Government launch says 80 developer/publisher respondents of varied scale.
assessment: Decisive primary author-uploaded full text. Adds 1,286 surveyed developer workers, split into 1,136 incorporated and 150 unincorporated. Survey respondent count, not national estimate; permanent, contract and internship statuses appear but no complete status totals recoverable from text. Preserve 1,136 as a component rather than an all-industry total.
access_status: public full text through ResearchGate author upload; government launch independently confirms provenance and 80 respondents
next_step: If an official Komdigi-hosted PDF is recovered, archive its binary. Do not use for national trend or compare directly to 2024 lower bound.

title: Siaran Pers No. 132/HM/KOMINFO/04/2021: Kominfo, LIPI dan AGI Luncurkan Buku Peta Ekosistem Industri Game Indonesia 2020
publisher: Ministry of Communication and Informatics / now Komdigi
methodology: Government release says research involved 80 developer and publisher respondents, from small teams without legal entities to companies with hundreds of people.
assessment: Authoritative provenance confirmation and respondent-count qualifier for the 2020 report. Does not itself publish the employment total.
next_step: Retain alongside the author-uploaded report to support attribution and survey scope.

title: Rencana Pengembangan Permainan Interaktif Nasional 2015-2019
publisher: Kementerian Pariwisata dan Ekonomi Kreatif / national creative-economy policy document
years: policy period 2015-2019; employment discussion covers 2010-2013, with 2013 value
methodology: Policy document presents a national creative-economy subsector series and identifies BPS data for economic statistics. It says the 2009 creative KBLI classifications did not fully match the proposed interactive-games scope; published text does not expose an auditable labour-force microdata method.
assessment: Useful historical national-scope figure: 23,928 workers in 2013. Scope is broad interactive games including electronic, online, physical, card and board games, so it is not a video-game developer series and must remain isolated.
access_status: public rendered copy; original government publication identity clear, binary not recovered in this pass
next_step: Seek an official ministry/BPS binary or underlying BPS table before treating 2010-2013 as a reusable annual series.

title: Peta Ekosistem Industri Gim Indonesia 2024: Menuju Transformasi Ekonomi Digital Nasional 2025+
years: study titled 2024; published October 2025; exact workforce observation date unstated
methodology: Existing baseline: public abstract does not disclose sampling or extrapolation details.
assessment: Already accepted in baseline: at least 2,112 talents at video-game developers and publishers; broad 513,000-1.03 million impact range is not core employment. Not duplicated in proposed observations.
access_status: public author summary / full-PDF availability not recovered during this bounded pass
next_step: Keep existing lower-bound treatment; do not reverse stated growth to create 2015 values.

title: Siaran Pers No. 278/HM/KOMINFO/07/2022 tentang Memanfaatkan Potensi Pasar Gim, Kominfo Gandeng AGI Tumbuhkan Game Developer Lokal
publisher: Ministry of Communication and Informatics / now Komdigi
years: published 2022; describes Peta Ekosistem Industri Game Indonesia 2021
methodology: 2021 edition was prepared with Niko Partners and adds gamer, public-opinion and local-company information.
assessment: Checked forward edition. No additional national or respondent employment stock was identified in the accessible official release.
next_step: No further action unless the full 2021 report yields an employment table absent from accessible text.

title: Peta Industri Game Indonesia 2015
publisher: Direktorat Pemberdayaan Industri Informatika, Ministry of Communication and Informatics
methodology: Not retrieved. The 2020 official report cites it as the previous Kominfo survey and compares company characteristics, but does not reproduce a dated workforce total in accessible text.
assessment: Original historical edition identified but no reliable employment observation extracted. Do not infer a value from the 2024 growth statement.
access_status: former official URL unavailable/not retrieved in this pass
